item.title: Dems aim to block Iran war funding. And, Army delays lead azide detonation in Iowa

item.title: Just how vulnerable are we to cyberattacks?
item.description: In a week of outages, we're thinking about the rising threat of AI-powered cyberattacks. But sometimes, it's not the most sophisticated attack that's concerning, but the easy targets buried in old software.

item.title: New York City unveils a bold plan to move its jails off Rikers Island
item.description: New York City officials are moving forward with plans to close Rikers, the city's main jail complex, after years of discussion. The jail has been plagued by assaults and inmate deaths.
